Purpose: AI agent reference for Rusty Commit (`rco`)—AI-powered commit message generator in Rust. Repo: https://github.com/hongkongkiwi/rusty-commit. Version 1.0.24 (last updated 2026-02-02). Binary: `rco` (`rusty-commit`). ~15,500 LOC, 58 files. Trait-based provider system, async/await (tokio). Key deps: tokio 1.35, clap 4.5, git2 0.20, async-openai 0.32, rmcp 0.13.  
Commands: `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd`.  
Do: **Verify `.gitignore`** excludes sensitive files before committing. **Use `keyring` for secure storage (falls back to file with 0o600 perms)**.  
Prohibit: `rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir. Modifying system files or installing system packages. **Never hardcode or log** API keys/tokens. **No `unwrap()`** in production paths (use `?`).
